architecture.title: Architectural BIM Services
architecture.subtitle: Intelligent 3D Visualization, Constructability & Code Validation
architecture.description: BIM Earth Consultancy provides comprehensive Architectural BIM services supporting projects from conceptual design through detailed design, documentation and construction. Our services include architectural 3D modeling, interior BIM, façade modeling, site development, BIM documentation, custom Revit family creation, Scan-to-BIM, as-built modeling, quantity takeoff and model updates.

interior.title: Structural BIM Services
interior.subtitle: Coordinated Analytical & Geometric Structural Detailing
interior.description: Our Structural BIM Services provide advanced, information-rich modeling solutions for the accurate digital representation and coordination of structural systems throughout the project lifecycle. We develop parametric structural BIM models for reinforced concrete, structural steel, foundations, framing systems, cores, slabs, beams, columns, walls and other structural components, supporting project requirements from LOD 100 through LOD 500.
interior.overview:
Our workflows facilitate the transition from structural design intent to detailed model development, incorporating project-specific standards, engineering information, material specifications and constructability requirements. We support design development, multidisciplinary coordination, structural documentation, quantity takeoff, shop drawing and fabrication workflows, while maintaining model accuracy through systematic revision management and model updates.

Our structured BIM approach delivers precise, coordinated and construction-focused structural models that enhance design quality, documentation efficiency, material quantification and overall project information management.

subServices.name: Structural Design Development
features: Conversion of structural design intent into BIM
Development of engineering drawings into 3D models
Integration of structural specifications and parameters
Model development based on approved structural information

bim.title: MEP BIM Services
bim.subtitle: Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing & Fire Protection Engineering
bim.description: BIM Earth Consultancy provides comprehensive MEP BIM Services covering Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing and Fire Protection systems through accurate, intelligent and coordinated BIM workflows.
bim.overview:
Our services include HVAC, mechanical piping, electrical systems, plumbing, drainage, fire protection, ELV and specialized building services, with model development aligned to project-specific LOD requirements.

We support design development, multidisciplinary coordination, documentation, quantity takeoff, fabrication-ready modeling, Scan-to-BIM and as-built BIM deliverables, enabling efficient coordination and reliable information management throughout the project lifecycle.

training.title: BIM Training Programs
training.subtitle: Industry-Ready Masterclasses in Revit Architecture, Revit Structure & Navisworks
training.description: At BIM Earth Consultancy, our Architectural Training Services are designed to develop practical, industry-oriented BIM skills and prepare learners for professional architectural workflows.
training.overview:
The training focuses on Revit Architecture, Navisworks, BIM fundamentals, architectural modeling, documentation, parametric families, project development, and model-based quantity workflows, with hands-on exercises based on real-world project requirements.

Our training combines technical knowledge with hands-on project experience to build job-ready BIM skills and professional modeling capabilities.

subServices.name: Structural BIM Training
features: RCC / Concrete Modeling & Structural Steel Modeling
